    # The two marker colors fill opposite 2x2 quadrants, with equal colors
    # on each diagonal; vertical marker positions determine which color starts.
    if len(markers) >= 2:

        # occupies upper-left and lower-right.
        split_r = (top + bottom) // 2
        split_c = (left + right) // 2
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
